description.value: A small working flower-and-vegetable farm tucked in the forest off Wilson Forest Service Road above Roberts Creek, offering raised tent platforms, hot showers, flush toilets, a cold plunge tub, and communal fire pit; the FSR approach is rideable but expect washboard.

address.value: 2089 East Wilson Forest Service Road, Roberts Creek, BC V0N 2W1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is rich, confirming the OSM address (2089 E. Wilson Forest Service Rd, Roberts Creek, BC V0N 2W1) and phone number (778) 835-0636. The site describes an actively operating campground and working micro flower/vegetable farm on the Sunshine Coast with multiple accommodation types, hot showers, a covered communal kitchen, and Hipcamp booking. No cyclist-specific amenities (hiker/biker sites, pump, tools, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community tag ('Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands') is incorrect — Roberts Creek is on the BC Sunshine Coast (mainland), not Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands.
Convenience store listing reads 'Opening July 1st' against a 2023 copyright date — unclear whether it has since opened or whether the site is not regularly maintained.
OSM mobile tag used in place of a standard phone tag; the phone field in the OSM record is blank.
WiFi noted as available only 'in certain spots' — limited connectivity for guests.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operating campground and farm with a working website, Hipcamp booking, hot showers, covered kitchen, and direct trail access — a solid fit for touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast.

wow_evidence: hot showers, a covered communal kitchen... cold plunge tub
